messages.subject: Mediation Question
parts:
Hello—

I am using lavaan sem() to run a serial mediation. The indirect effects should be equal to the product of the mediator estimates. For my results—and just about every example I see—the results are close to this, but not exact. Does anyone know why this is?

I thank you for your time and help—

Paul H.

Hello—

If you look at the example here on the lavaan site, you can see the regression estimate for a is 0.474 and for b is 0.788. The product of a and b is 0.373512. But the estimate of ab under defined parameters is 0.374.

In this example, you might think that this is just rounding, but with other examples, there doesn't seem to be rounding going on.

I thank you for your time.

messages.subject: Re: Mediation Question
parts:
You can find more precision using the nd= argument described on the class?lavaan help page.  

summary(fit, nd = 7)

With more precision, the results do align:

> a <- coef(fit)["a"]
> b <- coef(fit)["b"]
> a*b
        a
0.3735964
